session_notes: Peer consultation observed. Invalid tree built (MCR=1, sensitivity=0 via reversed labels). Peer taught threshold value. Asks 'Label değişken oluyor mu?' Precision question. 'MCR mi yoksa sensitivity mi hangisi daha önemli?' — B13 candidate.

B5.note: Mike inverted recommendable/not recommendable labels ('ters olmuş, böyle değil'), creating MCR=1, sensitivity=0. Recognized the error and corrected. B5-A1 confirmed (knows two labels exist and which should be positive). But error pattern suggests label-outcome link was initially tenuous. Acquire/Low.

B13.quote: MCR mi yoksa sensitivity mi hangisi daha önemli?
B13.note: Trade-off framing present. However: (1) this follows peer discussion context where peer had just explained threshold; (2) no post-query independent application documented; (3) question alone without a contextual consequence answer = B13-A2 not met. not_observed.

B2.note: Threshold supplied by peer ('arkadaşı 200 yaptım'). This instance excluded per Section 6 peer-as-teacher rule. Remaining self-initiated iterations: 2 (both on same variable). Acquire.
